The '''WED-15-D3 Treadwell''' was a model of [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] produced by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]. After the original [[WED-15 Treadwell droid/Legends|WED-15 Treadwell]] was discontinued due to low sales, the Cybot Galactica team received customer complaints about the move, and a request for new Treadwells. Responding to their customers, Cybot Galactica produced the WED-15-D3 several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later, marketed as a more affordable version of the original Treadwell.<ref name="CDD" />
